notes.title: Update.
notes.content:
1. Stops are now limited. It is necessary to have time to complete all the tasks in a certain time.
2. The behavior of opponents has been changed.
3. Added two new enemies.
4. Railway stations have been changed.
5. Increased train parking time.
6. Better optimization.
7. Unlocked previously inaccessible items marked with a question mark.
8. Various minor changes.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
Updating the game
     What is done:
1) Added tips for management at the beginning of the game.
2) Added tooltips for using items.
3) Increased running speed.
4) Reduced stamina consumption.
5) The number of spawning items has been increased.
6) Added the sound of locked doors.
7) The stations are slightly reduced in size.
In the next update:
1) Load optimization for long games and weak PCs.
2) Several new opponents.
3) Changing the logic of behavior of old opponents.
4) Random events on the train.
